1_25_dihydroxy_vitamin_d.description: Blood level of calcitriol, the active hormonal form of vitamin D, measured by a lab in pg/mL (or pmol/L).
1_25_dihydroxy_vitamin_d.notes: NOT the routine vitamin D status test: that is 25-hydroxyvitamin D (vitamin_d). Plain 'vitamin D' should link to vitamin_d unless '1,25' or 'calcitriol' is stated.

activity_hr_average.description: Average heart rate during tracked activity periods in the daily activity summary of a wearable (e.g. Withings), in bpm.
activity_hr_average.notes: Daily activity summary value; per-workout averages are workout_avg_hr.

activity_hr_max.description: Maximum heart rate during tracked activity periods in the daily activity summary of a wearable (e.g. Withings), in bpm.
activity_hr_max.notes: Daily activity summary; per-workout max is workout_max_hr, whole-day max is day_max_hr.

activity_hr_min.description: Minimum heart rate within the daily activity summary of a wearable (e.g. Withings), in bpm.
activity_hr_min.notes: Not resting heart rate (resting_heart_rate), though often close in value.

activity_score.description: Vendor composite daily activity score (0-100) such as the Oura Activity score, in score points.
activity_score.notes: Oura-style score. Whoop's analogous load metric is day_strain.

albumin.description: Serum albumin, the main blood protein made by the liver, measured by a lab in g/dL (or g/L).
albumin.notes: Not urine albumin / microalbumin (UACR), which is a kidney test. Not total protein or globulin.

alkaline_phosphatase.description: Serum alkaline phosphatase, an enzyme from liver, bile ducts and bone, measured by a lab in U/L (IU/L).
alkaline_phosphatase.notes: Part of a liver panel/CMP. 'Alkaline phosphate' is a common mis-statement of this enzyme.

alt.description: Alanine aminotransferase, a liver enzyme measured in blood by a lab in U/L (IU/L).
alt.notes: ALT is the most liver-specific of the transaminases. 'liver enzymes' generically also covers ast/ggt/alkaline_phosphatase.

apob.description: Apolipoprotein B, the protein on every atherogenic lipoprotein particle (LDL, VLDL, IDL, Lp(a)), measured by a lab in mg/dL (or g/L).
apob.notes: Not LDL-C (cholesterol mass). 'LDL-P' (NMR particle number) is a related but different assay; closest available id is apob.

ast.description: Aspartate aminotransferase, an enzyme from liver, heart and muscle, measured in blood by a lab in U/L (IU/L).
ast.notes: Also rises after intense exercise (muscle source). AST/ALT ratio is a common derived value.

awake_time.description: Time spent awake between falling asleep and final wake-up within a sleep period (wake after sleep onset), from a wearable or sleep sensor, in minutes.
awake_time.notes: Near-duplicate of wakeup_duration (Withings 'wakeupduration'); prefer awake_time for Oura/Whoop data. Count of awakenings -> wakeup_count.

basal_metabolic_rate.description: Basal metabolic rate, estimated resting daily energy expenditure, from a bioimpedance scale or wearable model, in kcal/day.
basal_metabolic_rate.notes: Resting only; total daily burn -> calories_burned.

basophils.description: Basophils, a white blood cell type from the CBC differential, reported by a lab as % of WBC and/or absolute count (x10^3/uL).
basophils.notes: Only one basophil id exists; check the unit to tell % from absolute count.

bedtime_hour.description: Clock time you went to bed / fell asleep for the main sleep period, from a wearable, expressed as hour of day.
lay_terms: what time I go to sleep
bedtime_hour.notes: A clock time, not a duration.

bioavailable_testosterone.description: Bioavailable testosterone (free plus albumin-bound, i.e. not SHBG-bound), measured or calculated by a lab in ng/dL.
bioavailable_testosterone.notes: NOT free testosterone (which is only the unbound ~2%; no separate id exists) and NOT total testosterone. Plain 'testosterone' or 'T level' -> total_testosterone.

blood_pressure.description: Arterial blood pressure (systolic over diastolic) from a cuff or wearable, in mmHg.
blood_pressure.notes: Combined reading. 'Top number' -> systolic_blood_pressure, 'bottom number' -> diastolic_blood_pressure.

bmi.description: Body mass index, weight divided by height squared, computed from scale/profile data, in kg/m2.
bmi.notes: Also exists as a profile field (bmi).

body_fat.description: Body fat percentage, the share of body weight that is fat, from a bioimpedance scale, DEXA or wearable, in %.

body_temp_deviation.description: Nightly deviation of body (finger/wrist skin) temperature from your personal baseline, from a wearable (Oura temperature deviation, Apple wrist temperature), in degrees Celsius.
body_temp_deviation.notes: Relative delta (can be negative), not an absolute temperature.

body_temperature.description: Core/absolute body temperature from a thermometer (e.g. Withings Thermo) or manual entry, in degrees Celsius.
body_temperature.notes: Absolute value. Oura-style nightly change from baseline -> body_temp_deviation; wrist/finger skin temp -> skin_temp.

bone_mass.description: Estimated bone mineral mass from a bioimpedance scale (or DEXA), in kg.
bone_mass.notes: Not bone mineral density (BMD / T-score, g/cm2), which has no id.

breathing_disturbance_index.description: Breathing disturbance index, the number of breathing disturbances per hour of sleep from an oximetry wearable or sleep sensor (Oura, Withings Sleep Analyzer), in events/hour.
breathing_disturbance_index.notes: Consumer approximation, not a clinical polysomnography AHI/RDI; AHI/RDI are listed only because users use them for this concept. Oura 'breathing regularity' is its banded view.

calories_active.description: Active energy burned through movement and exercise above resting metabolism, from a wearable, in kcal.
calories_active.notes: Apple Watch 'Move' ring = active energy. Not total calories_burned.

calories_burned.description: Total energy expenditure for the day (resting/basal plus active), from a wearable, in kcal.
calories_burned.notes: Total (includes BMR). Active-only -> calories_active; single workout -> workout_calories. Not calories eaten (intake has no id).

cardiovascular_age.description: Estimated cardiovascular (vascular) age derived from arterial stiffness / pulse wave data by a wearable or scale (Oura Cardiovascular Age, Withings vascular age), in years.
cardiovascular_age.notes: Not chronological age (profile birth year) and not biological/epigenetic age.

cholesterol.description: Total cholesterol from a lipid panel, measured by a lab in mg/dL (or mmol/L).
cholesterol.notes: Default for unqualified 'cholesterol'. 'Good' -> hdl, 'bad' -> ldl. Non-HDL cholesterol has no id.

cortisol_am.description: Morning (AM, typically 7-9 am) serum cortisol, the main stress hormone, measured by a lab in ug/dL (or nmol/L).
cortisol_am.notes: A lab hormone value; not the wearable stress metrics (stress_summary, stress_high_duration). Not salivary or evening cortisol.

creatinine.description: Serum creatinine, a muscle waste product cleared by the kidneys, measured by a lab in mg/dL (or umol/L).
creatinine.notes: 'Creatine' (the supplement) is a frequent misspelling, but a request about creatine supplementation is not this lab. Not urine creatinine or creatinine clearance. eGFR is computed from it.

day_avg_hr.description: Average heart rate across the whole day (24 h) from a continuously worn wearable, in bpm.
synonyms: mean heart rate for the day
day_avg_hr.notes: Whole-day average; not resting HR, workout average (workout_avg_hr), activity average (activity_hr_average) or sleep average (sleep_hr_average).

day_max_hr.description: Highest heart rate recorded over the whole day by a continuously worn wearable, in bpm.
synonyms: highest heart rate of the day
day_max_hr.notes: Whole-day peak. Not workout max (workout_max_hr), activity max (activity_hr_max) or sleep max (sleep_hr_max). Not the physiological/age-predicted HRmax.

day_strain.description: Whoop Day Strain, the cumulative cardiovascular load for the whole day on a 0-21 scale, in score points.
day_strain.notes: Whole day. Per-workout strain -> strain_score. Plain 'strain' is ambiguous: default to day_strain unless a workout is referenced.

dhea_sulfate.description: Dehydroepiandrosterone sulfate, an adrenal androgen precursor hormone, measured by a lab in ug/dL (or umol/L).
dhea_sulfate.notes: Plain 'DHEA' (unsulfated) is a separate assay, but in consumer panels it almost always means DHEA-S; link here with that caveat.

diastolic_blood_pressure.description: Diastolic blood pressure, the arterial pressure between heartbeats (the bottom number), from a cuff or wearable, in mmHg.

distance.description: Total distance walked/run/moved over the day, from a phone or wearable, in km.
distance.notes: Daily total; per-workout distance is workout_distance.

ecg_afib_classification.description: Atrial fibrillation classification result from a single-lead wearable ECG (Apple Watch, Withings, KardiaMobile, Fitbit), a categorical value (e.g. sinus rhythm, AFib, inconclusive).
ecg_afib_classification.notes: Categorical, not a number. ECG-derived heart rate is in heart_rate (existing alias ecg_heart_rate).

egfr.description: Estimated glomerular filtration rate, a kidney-function estimate calculated from creatinine (CKD-EPI equation), in mL/min/1.73m2.
egfr.notes: Derived from creatinine (and age/sex). Not EGFR the gene/receptor. Not cystatin-C eGFR unless the source says so.

electrochemical_skin_conductance.description: Electrochemical skin conductance of the feet/hands measuring sweat-gland (sudomotor) nerve function, from a smart scale (Withings Body Scan) or dedicated device, in microsiemens (uS).
electrochemical_skin_conductance.notes: Not wearable EDA stress (e.g. Fitbit EDA scan), which measures something different despite similar wording; EDA listed because users conflate them.

elevation.description: Elevation gained (climbed) over the day, from a wearable barometer or GPS, in meters.
elevation.notes: Not 'floors climbed' (a count of ~3 m floors, no id) and not altitude/location above sea level.

eosinophils.description: Eosinophils, a white blood cell type from the CBC differential linked to allergy and parasites, reported by a lab as % of WBC and/or absolute count (x10^3/uL).
eosinophils.notes: Only one eosinophil id; check the unit to tell % from absolute count.

extracellular_water.description: Water outside cells (plasma and interstitial fluid), estimated by a bioimpedance scale (e.g. Withings Body Scan), in kg.

fasting_glucose.description: Blood glucose measured after an overnight fast (typically 8+ hours), usually a lab test, in mg/dL (or mmol/L).
fasting_glucose.notes: Use when 'fasting' is stated or implied (lab panel). Unqualified 'blood sugar'/'glucose' (esp. CGM or random) -> glucose.

fasting_insulin.description: Serum insulin measured after an overnight fast, a lab marker of insulin resistance, in uIU/mL (or pmol/L).
fasting_insulin.notes: Not insulin dosing (medication). HOMA-IR is computed from fasting insulin x fasting glucose.

fat_free_mass.description: Fat-free mass (everything except fat: muscle, bone, water, organs), from a bioimpedance scale or DEXA, in kg.
fat_free_mass.notes: Kilograms; not muscle_mass (FFM also includes bone and water). Percentage -> lean_mass_percent.

fat_free_mass_left_arm.description: Fat-free (lean) mass of the left arm from segmental bioimpedance analysis (e.g. Withings Body Scan scale), in kg.
synonyms: fat-free mass of the left arm
fat_free_mass_left_arm.notes: Segmental value; whole-body total is fat_free_mass. Match side and limb exactly.

fat_free_mass_left_leg.description: Fat-free (lean) mass of the left leg from segmental bioimpedance analysis (e.g. Withings Body Scan scale), in kg.
synonyms: fat-free mass of the left leg
fat_free_mass_left_leg.notes: Segmental value; whole-body total is fat_free_mass. Match side and limb exactly.

fat_free_mass_right_arm.description: Fat-free (lean) mass of the right arm from segmental bioimpedance analysis (e.g. Withings Body Scan scale), in kg.
synonyms: fat-free mass of the right arm
fat_free_mass_right_arm.notes: Segmental value; whole-body total is fat_free_mass. Match side and limb exactly.

fat_free_mass_right_leg.description: Fat-free (lean) mass of the right leg from segmental bioimpedance analysis (e.g. Withings Body Scan scale), in kg.
synonyms: fat-free mass of the right leg
fat_free_mass_right_leg.notes: Segmental value; whole-body total is fat_free_mass. Match side and limb exactly.

fat_free_mass_torso.description: Fat-free (lean) mass of the torso (trunk) from segmental bioimpedance analysis (e.g. Withings Body Scan scale), in kg.
fat_free_mass_torso.notes: Segmental value; whole-body total is fat_free_mass. Match side and limb exactly.

fat_mass.description: Total body fat mass in kilograms, from a bioimpedance scale or DEXA scan.
fat_mass.notes: Kilograms; percentage -> body_fat. Segment values are fat_mass_<segment>.

fat_mass_left_arm.description: Fat mass of the left arm from segmental bioimpedance analysis (e.g. Withings Body Scan scale), in kg.
synonyms: fat mass of the left arm
fat_mass_left_arm.notes: Segmental value; whole-body total is fat_mass. Match side and limb exactly.

fat_mass_left_leg.description: Fat mass of the left leg from segmental bioimpedance analysis (e.g. Withings Body Scan scale), in kg.
synonyms: fat mass of the left leg
fat_mass_left_leg.notes: Segmental value; whole-body total is fat_mass. Match side and limb exactly.

fat_mass_right_arm.description: Fat mass of the right arm from segmental bioimpedance analysis (e.g. Withings Body Scan scale), in kg.
synonyms: fat mass of the right arm
fat_mass_right_arm.notes: Segmental value; whole-body total is fat_mass. Match side and limb exactly.

fat_mass_right_leg.description: Fat mass of the right leg from segmental bioimpedance analysis (e.g. Withings Body Scan scale), in kg.
synonyms: fat mass of the right leg
fat_mass_right_leg.notes: Segmental value; whole-body total is fat_mass. Match side and limb exactly.

fat_mass_torso.description: Fat mass of the torso (trunk) from segmental bioimpedance analysis (e.g. Withings Body Scan scale), in kg.
fat_mass_torso.notes: Segmental value; whole-body total is fat_mass. Match side and limb exactly.

ferritin.description: Serum ferritin, the storage form of iron and an acute-phase reactant, measured by a lab in ng/mL (or ug/L).
ferritin.notes: Not serum iron, transferrin, TIBC or transferrin saturation (no ids). Plain 'iron' questions most often mean ferritin here, but say so. Rises with inflammation.

free_t4.description: Free thyroxine, the unbound active fraction of the thyroid hormone T4, measured by a lab in ng/dL (or pmol/L).
free_t4.notes: Not total T4 or T3/free T3 (no ids). 'Thyroid' generically -> tsh first.

ggt.description: Gamma-glutamyl transferase, a liver/bile-duct enzyme sensitive to alcohol, measured by a lab in U/L (IU/L).
ggt.notes: 'GTT' is a misspelling here but also means glucose tolerance test - disambiguate by context.

glucose.description: Blood glucose level from a random/non-fasting lab draw, fingerstick meter or continuous glucose monitor (CGM), in mg/dL (or mmol/L).
glucose.notes: Default for unqualified 'blood sugar'. If the user says 'fasting' -> fasting_glucose; 'average/3-month blood sugar' -> hba1c.

hba1c.description: Hemoglobin A1c, the percentage of glycated hemoglobin reflecting average blood glucose over ~3 months, measured by a lab in % (or mmol/mol).
hba1c.notes: Not plain hemoglobin (Hgb/Hb). 'eAG' (estimated average glucose) is derived from this.

hdl.description: High-density lipoprotein cholesterol from a lipid panel, measured by a lab in mg/dL (or mmol/L).
hdl.notes: 'Good cholesterol' -> hdl; 'bad cholesterol' -> ldl; unqualified 'cholesterol' -> cholesterol (total).

heart_rate.description: Heart rate at a point in time or over a period from a wearable, ECG or blood-pressure cuff, in beats per minute (bpm).
heart_rate.notes: Generic/untagged HR. If the user says resting/sleeping/workout/daily max etc., use the specific id. 'Heart rate variability' is NOT this.

heart_rate_variability.description: Heart rate variability, beat-to-beat variation (usually RMSSD, sometimes SDNN) measured overnight or at rest by a wearable (Oura, Whoop, Apple Watch, Garmin), in milliseconds.
heart_rate_variability.notes: Apple Health reports SDNN; Oura/Whoop report RMSSD - values are not directly comparable. Garmin 'HRV Status' and Oura 'HRV balance' are derived views of this. Not heart rate.

height.description: Body height (stature) from manual entry or a device profile, in meters.
height.notes: Measured metric; the profile value is height_cm.

hematocrit.description: Hematocrit, the percentage of blood volume made up of red blood cells, from a CBC lab test, in %.
hematocrit.notes: Tracks closely with hemoglobin but is a different measurement (% vs g/dL).

hemoglobin.description: Hemoglobin concentration, the oxygen-carrying protein in red blood cells, from a CBC lab test, in g/dL (or g/L).
hemoglobin.notes: Not HbA1c (glycated hemoglobin) and not ferritin (iron stores), though lay users sometimes say 'iron' for either.

homa_ir.description: Homeostatic Model Assessment of Insulin Resistance, a unitless index calculated from fasting glucose and fasting insulin.
synonyms: homeostatic model assessment of insulin resistance
homa_ir.notes: Derived value: (fasting insulin uIU/mL x fasting glucose mg/dL) / 405. Not HOMA-B (beta-cell function).

homocysteine.description: Plasma total homocysteine, an amino acid linked to B-vitamin status and cardiovascular risk, measured by a lab in umol/L.
homocysteine.notes: 'Homocystine' is technically a different molecule but is almost always a misspelling of homocysteine in user text.

hr_zone_0.description: Time spent in heart-rate below zone 1 (roughly under 50% of max heart rate) - very light / at-rest, from a wearable (e.g. Whoop, Garmin, Polar), in minutes.
hr_zone_0.notes: Zone boundaries differ by vendor (Whoop uses zones 0-5 by % of max HR; Garmin/Polar use 1-5; Withings reports fewer zones). Match on the zone number the user says.

hr_zone_1.description: Time spent in heart-rate zone 1 (roughly 50-60% of max heart rate) - very light / recovery, from a wearable (e.g. Whoop, Garmin, Polar), in minutes.
hr_zone_1.notes: Zone boundaries differ by vendor (Whoop uses zones 0-5 by % of max HR; Garmin/Polar use 1-5; Withings reports fewer zones). Match on the zone number the user says.

hr_zone_2.description: Time spent in heart-rate zone 2 (roughly 60-70% of max heart rate) - light aerobic / fat-burning base, from a wearable (e.g. Whoop, Garmin, Polar), in minutes.
hr_zone_2.notes: Zone boundaries differ by vendor (Whoop uses zones 0-5 by % of max HR; Garmin/Polar use 1-5; Withings reports fewer zones). Match on the zone number the user says. 'Zone 2' is also a common name for a training style; still map here.

hr_zone_3.description: Time spent in heart-rate zone 3 (roughly 70-80% of max heart rate) - moderate aerobic / tempo, from a wearable (e.g. Whoop, Garmin, Polar), in minutes.
hr_zone_3.notes: Zone boundaries differ by vendor (Whoop uses zones 0-5 by % of max HR; Garmin/Polar use 1-5; Withings reports fewer zones). Match on the zone number the user says.

hr_zone_4.description: Time spent in heart-rate zone 4 (roughly 80-90% of max heart rate) - hard / threshold, from a wearable (e.g. Whoop, Garmin, Polar), in minutes.
hr_zone_4.notes: Zone boundaries differ by vendor (Whoop uses zones 0-5 by % of max HR; Garmin/Polar use 1-5; Withings reports fewer zones). Match on the zone number the user says.

hr_zone_5.description: Time spent in heart-rate zone 5 (roughly 90-100% of max heart rate) - maximal / VO2 max, from a wearable (e.g. Whoop, Garmin, Polar), in minutes.
hr_zone_5.notes: Zone boundaries differ by vendor (Whoop uses zones 0-5 by % of max HR; Garmin/Polar use 1-5; Withings reports fewer zones). Match on the zone number the user says.

hs_crp.description: High-sensitivity C-reactive protein, a low-level systemic inflammation marker used for cardiovascular risk, measured by a lab in mg/L.
hs_crp.notes: Duplicate concept with hscrp (same assay, different id; hs_crp is the catalog id, hscrp the inventory id). Standard CRP is a different, less sensitive assay with no separate id; plain 'CRP' may resolve here but should be flagged.

hscrp.description: High-sensitivity C-reactive protein, a low-level systemic inflammation marker used for cardiovascular risk, measured by a lab in mg/L.
hscrp.notes: Duplicate concept with hs_crp (inventory id vs catalog id). Resolve both together. Plain 'CRP' is a different, less sensitive assay; flag if linked here.

hydration.description: Total body water mass estimated by a bioimpedance scale (e.g. Withings 'hydration'), in kg.
hydration.notes: Kilograms of body water, not drinking/fluid intake. TBW = intracellular + extracellular water.

intense_activity_duration.description: Time spent in high-intensity (vigorous) activity during the day, from a wearable, in minutes.
intense_activity_duration.notes: Fitbit 'very active minutes', Oura 'high activity', Withings 'intense'.

intracellular_water.description: Water inside cells, estimated by a bioimpedance scale (e.g. Withings Body Scan), in kg.

ionic_calcium.description: Ionized (free) calcium, the physiologically active fraction of blood calcium, measured by a lab in mmol/L (or mg/dL).
ionic_calcium.notes: Not total serum calcium (no separate id) - plain 'calcium' is ambiguous; total Ca is albumin-dependent, ionized is not.

ldl.description: Low-density lipoprotein cholesterol from a lipid panel (calculated or direct), measured by a lab in mg/dL (or mmol/L).
ldl.notes: Selector alias 'ldl cholesterol' points to 'ldl_cholesterol' (not an id here) - it should resolve to ldl. LDL-P/particle number -> apob is the closest id.

lean_mass_percent.description: Lean (fat-free) mass as a percentage of body weight, from a bioimpedance scale or DEXA, in %.

light_activity_duration.description: Time spent in light-intensity activity (e.g. easy walking, chores) during the day, from a wearable, in minutes.
light_activity_duration.notes: Fitbit 'lightly active', Oura 'low activity', Withings 'soft'. Not light sleep.

lipoprotein_a.description: Lipoprotein(a), a genetically determined LDL-like particle and cardiovascular risk factor, measured by a lab in nmol/L (or mg/dL).
lipoprotein_a.notes: Duplicate concept with lp_a (same analyte, two ids). nmol/L and mg/dL are not interconvertible exactly. Not the LPA gene; not 'apolipoprotein A' (ApoA1).

lp_a.description: Lipoprotein(a), a genetically determined LDL-like particle and cardiovascular risk factor, measured by a lab in nmol/L (or mg/dL).
lp_a.notes: Duplicate concept with lipoprotein_a (same analyte, two ids); resolve both together.

lymphocytes.description: Lymphocytes (T, B and NK cells), a white blood cell type from the CBC differential, reported by a lab as % of WBC and/or absolute count (x10^3/uL).
lymphocytes.notes: Only one lymphocyte id; check the unit to tell % from absolute count. Neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio uses this.

magnesium_rbc.description: Red blood cell (intracellular) magnesium, a lab measure of tissue magnesium status, in mg/dL.
magnesium_rbc.notes: Only magnesium id available; serum magnesium is a different specimen (no id). 'RBC' here is the specimen, not the red cell count.

mch.description: Mean corpuscular hemoglobin, the average hemoglobin amount per red blood cell, from a CBC lab test, in pg.
mch.notes: Easily confused with MCHC (concentration, g/dL) - match the exact letters.

mchc.description: Mean corpuscular hemoglobin concentration, the average hemoglobin concentration within red blood cells, from a CBC lab test, in g/dL.
mchc.notes: Easily confused with MCH (per-cell amount, pg).

mcv.description: Mean corpuscular volume, the average size of red blood cells, from a CBC lab test, in fL.

moderate_activity_duration.description: Time spent in moderate-intensity activity during the day, from a wearable, in minutes.

monocytes.description: Monocytes, a white blood cell type from the CBC differential, reported by a lab as % of WBC and/or absolute count (x10^3/uL).
monocytes.notes: 'Mono' can also mean mononucleosis (infection) - disambiguate by context.

mpv.description: Mean platelet volume, the average size of platelets, from a CBC lab test, in fL.
mpv.notes: Not the platelet count and not MCV (red cell size).

muscle_mass.description: Skeletal/soft-tissue muscle mass from a bioimpedance scale or DEXA, in kg.
muscle_mass.notes: Not fat_free_mass (which includes bone and water). Segment values are muscle_mass_<segment>.

muscle_mass_left_arm.description: Muscle mass of the left arm from segmental bioimpedance analysis (e.g. Withings Body Scan scale), in kg.
synonyms: muscle mass of the left arm
muscle_mass_left_arm.notes: Segmental value; whole-body total is muscle_mass. Match side and limb exactly.

muscle_mass_left_leg.description: Muscle mass of the left leg from segmental bioimpedance analysis (e.g. Withings Body Scan scale), in kg.
synonyms: muscle mass of the left leg
muscle_mass_left_leg.notes: Segmental value; whole-body total is muscle_mass. Match side and limb exactly.

muscle_mass_right_arm.description: Muscle mass of the right arm from segmental bioimpedance analysis (e.g. Withings Body Scan scale), in kg.
synonyms: muscle mass of the right arm
muscle_mass_right_arm.notes: Segmental value; whole-body total is muscle_mass. Match side and limb exactly.

muscle_mass_right_leg.description: Muscle mass of the right leg from segmental bioimpedance analysis (e.g. Withings Body Scan scale), in kg.
synonyms: muscle mass of the right leg
muscle_mass_right_leg.notes: Segmental value; whole-body total is muscle_mass. Match side and limb exactly.

muscle_mass_torso.description: Muscle mass of the torso (trunk) from segmental bioimpedance analysis (e.g. Withings Body Scan scale), in kg.
muscle_mass_torso.notes: Segmental value; whole-body total is muscle_mass. Match side and limb exactly.

nerve_health_score_feet_max.description: Best (maximum) of the left and right foot nerve health scores from the Withings Body Scan ESC measurement, as a score.

nerve_health_score_left_foot.description: Nerve health score for the left foot from the Withings Body Scan ESC measurement, as a score.

nerve_health_score_right_foot.description: Nerve health score for the right foot from the Withings Body Scan ESC measurement, as a score.

nerve_response_score.description: Nerve response score summarising peripheral (sudomotor) nerve response from an ESC measurement, as a score.
nerve_response_score.notes: Exact vendor semantics unclear from the source vocabulary; related to but distinct from the foot nerve health scores.

neutrophils.description: Neutrophils, the most abundant white blood cell type, from the CBC differential, typically reported as % of WBC.
neutrophils.notes: Percentage form; the absolute count (ANC) is neutrophils_absolute. If a user gives a x10^3/uL value, prefer neutrophils_absolute.

neutrophils_absolute.description: Absolute neutrophil count, the number of neutrophils per volume of blood from the CBC differential, in x10^3/uL (10^9/L).
neutrophils_absolute.notes: Absolute count; the percentage is neutrophils.

platelet_count.description: Number of platelets (thrombocytes) per volume of blood from a CBC lab test, in x10^3/uL (10^9/L).
platelet_count.notes: Duplicate concept with platelets (same analyte, two ids); resolve both together.

platelets.description: Number of platelets (thrombocytes) per volume of blood from a CBC lab test, in x10^3/uL (10^9/L).
platelets.notes: Duplicate concept with platelet_count (same analyte, two ids); resolve both together.

pulse_wave_velocity.description: Pulse wave velocity, the speed of the arterial pulse wave as a measure of arterial stiffness, from a smart scale (e.g. Withings Body Cardio/Body Scan), in m/s.
pulse_wave_velocity.notes: Cardiovascular/vascular age is derived from this.

rbc_count.description: Red blood cell (erythrocyte) count per volume of blood from a CBC lab test, in x10^6/uL (10^12/L).
rbc_count.notes: 'RBC magnesium' refers to magnesium_rbc, not this count.

rdw.description: Red cell distribution width, the variation in red blood cell size, from a CBC lab test, in %.
rdw.notes: RDW-SD is reported in fL rather than %.

readiness_score.description: Oura Readiness score (0-100) combining HRV, resting heart rate, temperature, sleep and activity balance into a daily readiness estimate, in score points.
readiness_score.notes: Oura's headline daily score. Whoop's analog is recovery_score (%); prefer readiness_score when 'readiness' is said and recovery_score when 'recovery' is said.

recovery_high_duration.description: Time during the day spent in a high-recovery (restored) physiological state from Oura daytime stress tracking, in minutes.
recovery_high_duration.notes: A duration, not the Whoop recovery_score.

recovery_score.description: Whoop Recovery score, a daily 0-100% estimate of recovery based on HRV, resting heart rate, respiratory rate and sleep, in %.
recovery_score.notes: Garmin Body Battery (0-100 energy reserve) is the closest vendor analogue, not identical. Not recovery_high_duration (Oura daytime stress 'restored' minutes).

resilience_daytime_recovery.description: Oura Resilience contributor for how much you recovered during the daytime, as a score.

resilience_level.description: Oura Resilience level, a multi-week measure of ability to withstand physiological stress (limited/adequate/solid/strong/exceptional), as a score.
resilience_level.notes: Headline resilience; the three contributors are separate ids.

resilience_sleep_recovery.description: Oura Resilience contributor for how well you recovered during sleep, as a score.

resilience_stress.description: Oura Resilience contributor reflecting the balance of stress versus recovery load, as a score.

respiratory_rate.description: Breathing rate, usually averaged overnight, from a wearable or sleep sensor (Oura, Whoop, Apple Watch), in breaths per minute.
respiratory_rate.notes: 'RR' can also mean R-R interval (HRV context) - disambiguate.

resting_heart_rate.description: Resting heart rate, the lowest steady heart rate at rest or during sleep, from a wearable (Oura, Whoop, Apple Watch, Garmin, Fitbit), in bpm.
resting_heart_rate.notes: Oura 'lowest resting heart rate' and Whoop 'RHR' map here. Not sleep average HR (sleep_hr_average), though close.

reticulocyte_production_index.description: Reticulocyte production index, the reticulocyte percentage corrected for hematocrit and maturation time, a calculated unitless index of bone-marrow red cell output.
reticulocyte_production_index.notes: Derived from reticulocytes and hematocrit; not the raw reticulocyte %/count.

reticulocytes.description: Reticulocytes, immature red blood cells, reported by a lab as % of red cells and/or absolute count.
reticulocytes.notes: Raw %/count; the corrected index is reticulocyte_production_index.

sedentary_time.description: Time spent sitting or inactive (awake) during the day, from a wearable, in minutes.

skin_temp.description: Skin temperature measured by a wearable sensor (e.g. Whoop skin temp), in degrees Celsius.
skin_temp.notes: Absolute skin reading (lower than core temperature).

sleep_consistency.description: Whoop sleep consistency, how similar your sleep and wake times are day to day, in %.
lay_terms: going to bed at the same time
sleep_consistency.notes: Not Oura 'breathing regularity' and not 'sleep efficiency'.

sleep_deep.description: Time spent in deep (slow-wave, N3) sleep during a night, from a wearable or sleep sensor, in minutes.

sleep_efficiency.description: Sleep efficiency, the percentage of time in bed actually spent asleep, from a wearable or sleep sensor, in %.
synonyms: time asleep vs time in bed
sleep_efficiency.notes: Not Whoop 'sleep performance' (sleep obtained vs sleep needed). 'Sleep quality' is ambiguous - may also mean sleep_score.

sleep_hr_average.description: Average heart rate during a sleep session from a wearable or under-mattress sensor (Oura, Whoop, Withings Sleep), in bpm.
sleep_hr_average.notes: Close to but not the same as resting_heart_rate (Oura's RHR is the lowest 5-min average during sleep).

sleep_hr_max.description: Maximum heart rate during a sleep session from a wearable or under-mattress sensor, in bpm.

sleep_latency.description: Sleep latency (sleep onset latency), the time taken to fall asleep after going to bed, from a wearable or sleep sensor, in minutes.
lay_terms: how long it took me to fall asleep
sleep_latency.notes: Not wakeup_latency (time from waking to getting up).

sleep_light.description: Time spent in light (N1/N2) sleep during a night, from a wearable or sleep sensor, in minutes.
sleep_light.notes: Apple Health calls this 'Core' sleep. Not 'light activity' (light_activity_duration).

sleep_performance.description: Whoop sleep performance, the percentage of the sleep you needed that you actually obtained, in %.

sleep_rem.description: Time spent in rapid-eye-movement (REM) sleep during a night, from a wearable or sleep sensor, in minutes.

sleep_rr_max.description: Highest respiratory (breathing) rate during a sleep session, from a wearable or sleep sensor, in breaths/min.

sleep_rr_min.description: Lowest respiratory (breathing) rate during a sleep session, from a wearable or sleep sensor, in breaths/min.

sleep_score.description: Vendor composite sleep score (0-100) from a wearable such as Oura, Fitbit, Garmin or Withings, in score points.
sleep_score.notes: Device-reported score. The app's own composite is vita_sleep_score. Whoop's equivalent headline is sleep_performance.

snoring_duration.description: Total time spent snoring during a night, from an under-mattress sensor or phone/wearable microphone (e.g. Withings Sleep Analyzer), in seconds.

snoring_episodes.description: Number of distinct snoring episodes during a night, from an under-mattress sensor or phone/wearable microphone, as a count.

spo2.description: Peripheral blood oxygen saturation from a pulse oximeter or wearable (Oura, Apple Watch, Garmin Pulse Ox, Whoop), in %.
spo2.notes: Selector alias 'spo2'/'oxygen saturation'/'o2 sats' currently point to 'oxygen_saturation', which is not an id here - they should resolve to spo2. SaO2 is technically arterial (blood gas) but users mean this.

steps.description: Number of steps taken per day (or period), from a phone, watch, ring or fitness tracker, as a step count.

strain_score.description: Whoop workout (activity) strain, the cardiovascular load of a single workout on a 0-21 scale, in score points.
strain_score.notes: Per-workout. Vita registry display name 'Workout strain'. Bare 'strain score' is day_strain (spec v1.6 10c).

stress_high_duration.description: Time during the day spent in a high-stress physiological state from wearable stress tracking (Oura daytime stress, Garmin stress), in minutes.
stress_high_duration.notes: Wearable physiological stress, not the cortisol lab.

stress_summary.description: Daily stress state summary from wearable stress tracking (e.g. Oura day summary: restored/normal/stressful; Garmin stress level), as a score/category.

systolic_blood_pressure.description: Systolic blood pressure, the peak arterial pressure during a heartbeat (the top number), from a cuff or wearable, in mmHg.

total_sleep.description: Total time actually asleep in a night (sum of light, deep and REM), from a wearable or sleep sensor, in minutes.
total_sleep.notes: Time asleep, not time in bed. Whoop 'hours of sleep' and Oura 'total sleep' map here.

total_testosterone.description: Total serum testosterone (free plus SHBG- and albumin-bound), measured by a lab in ng/dL (or nmol/L).
total_testosterone.notes: Default for plain 'testosterone'. Free testosterone has no id (closest is bioavailable_testosterone, but they differ).

triglycerides.description: Triglycerides, the main blood fat measured on a lipid panel, in mg/dL (or mmol/L).

tsh.description: Thyroid-stimulating hormone (thyrotropin), the pituitary signal that drives thyroid output, measured by a lab in mIU/L (uIU/mL).
tsh.notes: Default for plain 'thyroid' questions. Inverse relationship to free T4.

uric_acid.description: Serum uric acid, the end product of purine metabolism linked to gout, measured by a lab in mg/dL (or umol/L).
uric_acid.notes: 'UA' also commonly means urinalysis - disambiguate by context.

visceral_fat.description: Visceral fat index, a unitless rating of fat stored around the abdominal organs, from a bioimpedance scale (Withings, Tanita, Omron).
visceral_fat.notes: Unitless index (typically 1-59); not a percentage or kg.

vita_sleep_score.description: The assistant's own (Vita) composite sleep score computed across connected devices, in score points.
lay_terms: my sleep score in the app
vita_sleep_score.notes: Use when the user names Vita or the app's score; device-native scores are sleep_score.

vitamin_b12.description: Serum vitamin B12 (cobalamin), measured by a lab in pg/mL (or pmol/L).
vitamin_b12.notes: Not MMA or holotranscobalamin (active B12), which are separate assays.

vitamin_d.description: 25-hydroxyvitamin D (calcidiol), the standard vitamin D status test, measured by a lab in ng/mL (or nmol/L).

vo2_max.description: Estimated VO2 max, the maximal oxygen uptake / cardiorespiratory fitness, from a wearable (Apple Cardio Fitness, Garmin VO2 max, Oura Cardio Capacity) or lab test, in mL/kg/min.
vo2_max.notes: 'V02' with a zero is a very common misspelling.

wake_hour.description: Clock time you woke up at the end of the main sleep period, from a wearable, expressed as hour of day.
wake_hour.notes: A clock time; not wakeup_count or wakeup_duration.

wakeup_count.description: Number of times you woke up during a sleep period, from a sleep sensor or wearable (e.g. Withings Sleep), as a count.
lay_terms: how many times I woke up
wakeup_count.notes: A count; time awake is awake_time / wakeup_duration.

wakeup_duration.description: Total time spent awake during a sleep period as reported by a sleep sensor (Withings 'wakeup duration'), in minutes.
wakeup_duration.notes: Near-duplicate of awake_time; comes from Withings. Not wakeup_latency.

wakeup_latency.description: Time between final wake-up and getting out of bed, from a sleep sensor (Withings 'duration to wake up/get up'), in minutes.
synonyms: time to get out of bed
lay_terms: how long before I got up

wbc_count.description: Total white blood cell (leukocyte) count per volume of blood from a CBC lab test, in x10^3/uL (10^9/L).
wbc_count.notes: Duplicate concept with white_blood_cells (same analyte, two ids); resolve both together. Differential cell types are separate ids.

weight.description: Body weight from a scale or manual entry, in kg.
weight.notes: Measured metric; the static profile value is profile field weight_kg.

white_blood_cells.description: Total white blood cell (leukocyte) count per volume of blood from a CBC lab test, in x10^3/uL (10^9/L).
white_blood_cells.notes: Duplicate concept with wbc_count (same analyte, two ids); resolve both together.

workout_avg_hr.description: Average heart rate during a recorded workout session from a wearable or chest strap, in bpm.

workout_calories.description: Energy burned during a single recorded workout session, from a wearable, in kcal.

workout_distance.description: Distance covered during a single recorded workout (run, ride, walk), from a wearable/GPS, in km.
lay_terms: how far I walked in my workout

workout_intensity.description: Intensity rating of a single recorded workout (e.g. Oura easy/moderate/hard), as a score.
workout_intensity.notes: Vendor intensity label/score; RPE listed only for user phrasing (subjective rating).

workout_max_hr.description: Maximum heart rate reached during a recorded workout session from a wearable or chest strap, in bpm.
lay_terms: peak heart rate in my run

panel_lipid.description: Lipid panel: a named group read as its members (spec v1.8 10g.16/10g.18): cholesterol, ldl, hdl, triglycerides, apob, lipoprotein_a, lp_a, nonhdl_cholesterol, non_hdl_cholesterol, vldl_cholesterol.

panel_thyroid.description: Thyroid panel: a named group read as its members (spec v1.8 10g.16/10g.18): tsh, free_t4, free_t3, total_t4, total_t3.

panel_cbc.description: Complete blood count: a named group read as its members (spec v1.8 10g.16/10g.18): white_blood_cells, wbc_count, rbc_count, hemoglobin, hematocrit, mcv, mch, mchc, rdw, platelets, platelet_count, mpv, neutrophils, neutrophils_absolute, lymphocytes, monocytes, eosinophils, basophils.

panel_cbc_basic.description: CBC without differential: a named group read as its members (spec v1.8 10g.16/10g.18): white_blood_cells, wbc_count, rbc_count, hemoglobin, hematocrit, mcv, mch, mchc, rdw, platelets, platelet_count, mpv.

panel_body_comp.description: Body composition: a named group read as its members (spec v1.8 10g.16/10g.18): weight, body_fat, fat_mass, fat_free_mass, lean_mass_percent, muscle_mass, bone_mass, visceral_fat, hydration.

panel_body_water.description: Body water compartments: a named group read as its members (spec v1.8 10g.16/10g.18): hydration, intracellular_water, extracellular_water.

panel_fat_segments.description: Fat by body segment: a named group read as its members (spec v1.8 10g.16/10g.18): fat_mass_left_arm, fat_mass_right_arm, fat_mass_left_leg, fat_mass_right_leg, fat_mass_torso.

panel_muscle_segments.description: Muscle by body segment: a named group read as its members (spec v1.8 10g.16/10g.18): muscle_mass_left_arm, muscle_mass_right_arm, muscle_mass_left_leg, muscle_mass_right_leg, muscle_mass_torso.

panel_lean_segments.description: Lean mass by body segment: a named group read as its members (spec v1.8 10g.16/10g.18): fat_free_mass_left_arm, fat_free_mass_right_arm, fat_free_mass_left_leg, fat_free_mass_right_leg, fat_free_mass_torso.

panel_segmental.description: Segmental analysis: a named group read as its members (spec v1.8 10g.16/10g.18): fat_mass_left_arm, fat_mass_right_arm, fat_mass_left_leg, fat_mass_right_leg, fat_mass_torso, muscle_mass_left_arm, muscle_mass_right_arm, muscle_mass_left_leg, muscle_mass_right_leg, muscle_mass_torso, fat_free_mass_left_arm, fat_free_mass_right_arm, fat_free_mass_left_leg, fat_free_mass_right_leg, fat_free_mass_torso.

workout_hr.description: Workout heart rate: a named group read as its members (spec v1.8 10g.16/10g.18): workout_avg_hr, workout_max_hr.

profile.description: The user's stored health profile: demographics, goals, medications, conditions, allergies and preferences.

workouts.description: Individual recorded exercise sessions (type, duration, distance, heart rate, calories, strain) synced from wearables and fitness apps.

labs.description: Uploaded laboratory reports (blood tests and panels) with their extracted biomarker results.

calendar.description: The user's health calendar: planned screenings, checkups, appointments and health-plan events.

overview.description: A curated overview of the user's recent health: sleep, recovery, heart, activity, body composition and key labs (spec v1.8 10g.10).

bio.description: Free-text self-description written by the user.

birth_day.description: Day of month of the user's birth date.

birth_month.description: Month of the user's birth date.

birth_year.description: Year of birth, used to derive age.

bmi.description: Body mass index stored on the profile (static, not the time-series metric).

challenges.description: Health challenges or obstacles the user reports (e.g. poor sleep, low energy).

ethnicity.description: Self-reported ethnicity/ancestry (relevant to some reference ranges and risk scores).

experience_level.description: Self-reported training/health-tracking experience level (e.g. beginner, intermediate, advanced).

family_history.description: Health conditions in close relatives (e.g. heart disease, diabetes, cancer).

goals.description: The user's stated health and fitness goals.

height_cm.description: Height stored on the profile, in centimeters.

homebase.description: The user's home location/region (city or country).

medications.description: Medications and supplements the user currently takes.

monthly_budget.description: Monthly budget the user is willing to spend on health (tests, supplements, services).

no_regular_medications.description: Flag indicating the user takes no regular medications.

sex.description: Biological sex used for reference ranges and calculations.

tracking_methods.description: Devices and methods the user uses to track health (e.g. Oura, Whoop, Apple Watch, labs).

weight_kg.description: Weight stored on the profile, in kilograms.

years_smoking.description: Number of years the user has smoked (for pack-year/risk estimates).
